metadata.description: Zone-specific file upload governance policies for Copilot Studio agents

Zone 1.description: Personal Productivity — file upload at maker discretion

Zone 2.description: Team Collaboration — file upload requires governance approval and High moderation minimum

Zone 3.description: Enterprise Managed — file upload disabled by default; if enabled requires Highest moderation

Zone3_FileUploadEnabled_NoApproval.description: File upload enabled in Zone 3 without documented approval

Zone3_FileUploadEnabled_InsufficientMode.description: File upload enabled in Zone 3 without Highest content moderation

Zone2_FileUploadEnabled_InsufficientMode.description: File upload enabled in Zone 2 without High content moderation minimum

Zone2_FileUploadEnabled_NoApproval.description: File upload enabled in Zone 2 without documented approval

Unknown_Zone_FileUploadEnabled.description: File upload enabled on agent in unclassified environment

Zone1_NoModeration.description: File upload enabled in Zone 1 without content moderation configured

supportedFileTypes.note: Platform-level restriction — not configurable per agent
